title: External pitch curve, input of the command segment (notes.md): the network path writes it, the segmenter cuts the notes
description: Same frame rules as the sidecar (noten_kurve.schema.json): arrays of frameZahl(frames) entries, f0_ct with two decimals, konf with three. The curve id of the resulting sidecar is <detektor_version>.noten_hmm-1.
